title: Fix Sales FR feature activation data migration
summary: Sales FR feature activation now uses RecordRef-based copying instead of DataTransfer to avoid execution errors outside installation or upgrade sessions.
key_points: Replaced DataTransfer with RecordRef-based record copying during feature activation
DataTransfer usage retained for CLEAN30 installation and upgrade scenarios
Preserves non-default source filters and skips OnModify triggers in the new approach
Fixes feature activation failure in the Sales FR app
quote: Enabling the Sales FR feature fails because its migration uses DataTransfer outside an installation or upgrade session.
